slice: Re-evaluate native floating add-zero normalization after the Boolean cast optimization
decision: Keep the native add-zero candidate deferred. The former FLOAT comparison regression is not reproduced on the accepted Boolean kernel, but the pure DOUBLE long-list control remains slower in independent comparisons. No additional Rust runtime patch is adopted.
scope: Re-evaluate the exact previous candidate. Both variants include the accepted Boolean-to-numeric Arrow kernel. Only the Sail common.rs candidate differs. The planner Column guard also admits computed inputs exposed by subquery or CTE aliases; direct computed operands still take the previous path.

The candidate patch is byte-for-byte identical to float-in-zero-only-results.json. Arrow native unit tests are not rerun because the tested Arrow source and compiled libraries are identical to the accepted Boolean experiment.

performance.method: All builds and correctness probes finish before timing. CPU 2, 1048576 rows per query, 8192-row batches, two warmups and nine samples per fresh process. Main series use four balanced processes per variant/case/phase. Report medians of process medians. Execution and planning counters are gated separately and fully scheduled. No builds, tests, profiles or other timing runs execute concurrently. Delta I/O is excluded.

Same-before and same-after overall medians differ by +0.32% and -0.23%. Do not dismiss the remaining difference as timing noise.

The selected IN hash loop accounts for about 95% of sampled cycles in all four profiles. It has 127 identical normalized instructions in both binaries, but starts at different offsets modulo 64. This does not establish code alignment, hash seeds, data placement or processor behavior as the cause. The selected symbol is not a comparison of the entire executable.

The wider suite also has smaller regressions, including legacy DOUBLE long IN +1.35%, dynamic FLOAT IN +1.26%, and dynamic DOUBLE IN +1.23%. These are single broad-series results, not individually isolated. Selected planning timings also increase.

The native candidate still allocates the normalized values buffer and retains fallback costs for NaN/unknown lists, direct computed operands and FLOAT widening. Aliased computed inputs can qualify, as the new plan checks demonstrate; their performance is not measured.
The DOUBLE zero_wide benchmark duplicates zero_short SQL/data. Zero long lists mostly match and do not cover other selectivities. All timing results are from one machine/core and one batch size.

import json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(__file__).parent
cases=[];expected={}
for source,values in [('DECIMAL(18,4)',[0,1.25,-1.25,None]),('BIGINT',[0,1,-1,None])]:
    table=','.join(f'({i},CAST({value if value is not None else "NULL"} AS {source}))' for i,value in enumerate(values))
    for kind,cast in [('subquery_cast','CAST(v AS DOUBLE)'),('subquery_try','TRY_CAST(v AS DOUBLE)'),('cte_cast','CAST(v AS DOUBLE)')]:
        inner=f'SELECT id,{cast} AS x FROM (VALUES {table}) t(id,v)'
        prefix=f'WITH q AS ({inner}) ' if kind=='cte_cast' else ''
        relation='q' if kind=='cte_cast' else f'({inner}) q'
        for negated in [False,True]:
            predicate=f'x {"NOT IN" if negated else "IN"} (CAST(0 AS DOUBLE),CAST(1.25 AS DOUBLE),CAST(2 AS DOUBLE))'
            answers=[None if v is None else int((v in [0,1.25,2]) != negated) for v in values]
            for filtered in [False,True]:
                case_id=f'{source[:3].lower()}_{kind}_{negated}_{filtered}'
                sql=prefix+(f'SELECT id FROM {relation} WHERE {predicate} ORDER BY id' if filtered else f'SELECT id,CAST({predicate} AS INT) AS r FROM {relation} ORDER BY id')
                cases.append({'id':case_id,'sql':sql,'batch_size':2})
                expected[case_id]=([[str(i)] for i,a in enumerate(answers) if a==1] if filtered else [[str(i),str(a) if a is not None else None] for i,a in enumerate(answers)])
file=p/'alias-controls.jsonl';file.write_text(''.join(json.dumps(c)+'\n' for c in cases))
captures={}
for variant in ['before','after']:
    output=p/f'{variant}-alias-controls.json'
    subprocess.run([str(p/f'{variant}-probe'),str(file),str(output),'--physical-plans'],capture_output=True,check=True)
    captures[variant]=json.loads(output.read_text())
    assert len(captures[variant]['results'])==48
    for row in captures[variant]['results']:
        assert row['actual']['status']=='ok',row['id']
        assert row['actual']['rows']==expected[row['id'].rsplit('_',1)[0]],row['id']
changes=[]
for a,b in zip(captures['before']['results'],captures['after']['results'],strict=True):
    assert a['id']==b['id']
    fields=sorted(k for k in a['actual'].keys()|b['actual'].keys() if a['actual'].get(k)!=b['actual'].get(k))
    assert set(fields)<={'logical_plan','physical_plan'},(a['id'],fields)
    if fields:changes.append({'id':a['id'],'fields':fields,'before':a['actual'],'after':b['actual']})
report={'observations':48,'independent_expected_rows':expected,'cases':cases,'changes':changes,'captures':captures}
(p/'alias-control-check.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print('48 aliased computed-input observations checked; changed plans:',len(changes),flush=True)

import json
import hashlib
import os
import statistics
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

p = Path(__file__).parent
out = p / 'generic-measurements'

load = lambda f: json.loads(Path(f).read_text())
assert (p / 'restoration.json').exists()
assert load(p / 'build-identity.json')['query_values_types_and_status_identical']
canonical = {v: {r['id']: r for r in load(p / f'{v}-check.json')['results']} for v in ['before', 'after']}
cases = [r['id'].removesuffix('_ansitrue') for r in canonical['before'].values() if r['ansi']]
planning = ['generic_in_utf8_low', 'generic_in_utf8_long_list', 'generic_in_decimal_low',
            'generic_in_float_zero_single', 'generic_in_double_zero_single',
            'generic_in_float_zero_short', 'generic_in_double_zero_short',
            'generic_in_float_zero_long_list', 'generic_in_double_zero_long_list',
            'generic_in_float_zero_nullable', 'generic_in_double_zero_nullable',
            'generic_in_float_zero_wide', 'generic_in_double_nan_short']
env = os.environ.copy()
assert not any(k.startswith(('MALLOC_', 'GLIBC_', 'LD_PRELOAD', 'DECIMAL_BENCH_')) for k in env)
order = ['before', 'after', 'after', 'before', 'after', 'before', 'before', 'after']
binary_sha256 = {v: hashlib.sha256((p / f'{v}-bench').read_bytes()).hexdigest() for v in ['before', 'after']}
runs = []
for index, variant in enumerate(order):
    for phase, selected in [('execution', cases), ('planning', planning)]:
        shift = index % len(selected)
        for case in selected[shift:] + selected[:shift]:
            directory = out / f'{index}-{variant}-{phase}-{case}'
            directory.mkdir()
            for name in ['control', 'ack']: os.mkfifo(directory / name)
            command = ['perf', 'stat', '--delay=-1', f'--control=fifo:{directory}/control,{directory}/ack',
                       '--json-output', '-o', str(directory / 'counters.jsonl'), '-e',
                       '{instructions:u,cycles:u},task-clock:u,context-switches:u,cpu-migrations:u,page-faults:u',
                       '--', 'taskset', '-c', '2', str(p / f'{variant}-bench'),
                       str(directory / 'capture.json'), 'generic-in', case]
            result = subprocess.run(command, env=env | {'DECIMAL_BENCH_PERF_DIR': str(directory),
                                    'DECIMAL_BENCH_PERF_PHASE': phase}, capture_output=True, text=True,
                                    check=True, timeout=180)
            capture = load(directory / 'capture.json')
            assert len(capture['results']) == 2
            for row in capture['results']:
                assert {k: v for k, v in row.items() if k not in ['samples_ms', 'planning_samples_ms']} == canonical[variant][row['id']]
            timed = next(r for r in capture['results'] if r['ansi'])
            assert len(timed['samples_ms']) == len(timed['planning_samples_ms']) == 9
            counters = [json.loads(line) for line in (directory / 'counters.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('{')]
            assert len(counters) == 6 and all(c['pcnt-running'] == 100 for c in counters)
            assert result.stderr.count('Events enabled') == 1
            runs.append({'variant': variant, 'index': index, 'phase': phase, 'case': case,
                         'command': command, 'planning_samples_ms': timed['planning_samples_ms'],
                         'samples_ms': timed['samples_ms'], 'counters': counters})
    (p / 'generic-performance.json').write_text(json.dumps({'binary_sha256': binary_sha256, 'order': order, 'cases': cases, 'planning': planning, 'runs': runs}, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(index, variant, 'complete', flush=True)

summary = {}
for phase, selected in [('execution', cases), ('planning', planning)]:
    summary[phase] = {}
    for case in selected:
        groups = {}
        for variant in ['before', 'after']:
            rows = [r for r in runs if r['variant'] == variant and r['case'] == case and r['phase'] == phase]
            assert len(rows) == 4
            medians = [statistics.median(r['planning_samples_ms' if phase == 'planning' else 'samples_ms']) for r in rows]
            instructions = [next(float(c['counter-value']) for c in r['counters'] if c['event'] == 'instructions:u') for r in rows]
            groups[variant] = {'process_medians_ms': medians, 'median_ms': statistics.median(medians),
                               'process_instructions': instructions, 'median_instructions': statistics.median(instructions)}
        summary[phase][case] = groups | {
            'latency_change_pct': 100 * (groups['after']['median_ms'] / groups['before']['median_ms'] - 1),
            'instruction_change_pct': 100 * (groups['after']['median_instructions'] / groups['before']['median_instructions'] - 1)}
(p / 'generic-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + '\n')
for phase, rows in summary.items():
    for case, row in rows.items():
        print(phase, case, round(row['latency_change_pct'], 2), round(row['instruction_change_pct'], 2), flush=True)

targets = ['float_in_f32_ansitrue', 'float_in_f64_ansitrue', 'in_f64_nulls_ansitrue', 'float_compare_f32_ansitrue', 'float_compare_f64_ansitrue', 'float_compare_mixed_ansitrue', 'float_in_dynamic_ansitrue', 'in_f64_long_ansitrue', 'in_f64_dynamic_ansitrue', 'in_f64_not_null_ansitrue', 'projected_nullable_ansitrue']
references = []
canonical = {v: {r['id']: r for r in json.loads((p / f'{v}-subquery-check.json').read_text())['results']} for v in ['before', 'after']}
base = os.environ.copy()
assert not any(k.startswith(('MALLOC_', 'GLIBC_', 'LD_PRELOAD', 'DECIMAL_BENCH_')) for k in base)
order = ['before', 'after', 'after', 'before', 'after', 'before', 'before', 'after']
experiments = [(v, i, references if v == 'reference' else controls + targets) for i, v in enumerate(order)]
binary_sha256 = {v: hashlib.sha256((p / f'{v}-bench').read_bytes()).hexdigest() for v in ['before', 'after']}
runs = []
for variant, index, cases in experiments:
    for phase in ['planning', 'execution']:
        selected = cases if phase == 'execution' else ['float_compare_f32_ansitrue', 'in_integer_ansitrue', 'no_division_ansitrue']
        shift = index % len(selected)
        for case in selected[shift:] + selected[:shift]:
            directory = out / f'{index:02}-{variant}-{phase}-{case}'
            directory.mkdir()
            for name in ['control', 'ack']:
                os.mkfifo(directory / name)
            command = ['perf', 'stat', '--delay=-1', f'--control=fifo:{directory}/control,{directory}/ack', '--json-output', '-o', str(directory / 'counters.jsonl'), '-e', '{instructions:u,cycles:u},task-clock:u,context-switches:u,cpu-migrations:u,page-faults:u', '--', 'taskset', '-c', '2', str(p / f'{variant}-bench'), str(directory / 'capture.json'), 'subqueries', case]
            env = base | {'DECIMAL_BENCH_RETAIN': 'none', 'DECIMAL_BENCH_PERF_DIR': str(directory), 'DECIMAL_BENCH_PERF_PHASE': phase}
            result = subprocess.run(command, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=180)
            capture = json.loads((directory / 'capture.json').read_text())
            assert len(capture['results']) == 1
            r = capture['results'][0]
            for field, value in canonical[variant][case].items():
                assert r[field] == value, (variant, case, field)
            assert r['retention'] == 'none' and r['retained_rows'] == 0
            counters = [json.loads(x) for x in (directory / 'counters.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if x.startswith('{')]
            assert len(counters) == 6 and all(x['pcnt-running'] == 100 for x in counters)
            assert result.stderr.count('Events enabled') == 1
            assert len(r['samples_ms']) == len(r['planning_samples_ms']) == 9
            samples = r['planning_samples_ms' if phase == 'planning' else 'samples_ms']
            runs.append({'variant': variant, 'phase': phase, 'index': index, 'case': case, 'command': command, 'planning_samples_ms': r['planning_samples_ms'], 'samples_ms': r['samples_ms'], 'counters': counters, 'median_ms': statistics.median(samples)})
    (p / 'performance.json').write_text(json.dumps({'binary_sha256': binary_sha256, 'order': order, 'controls': controls, 'targets': targets, 'runs': runs}, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(variant, index, 'complete', flush=True)


def stats(rows):
    medians = [r['median_ms'] for r in rows]
    instructions = [next(float(c['counter-value']) for c in r['counters'] if c['event'] == 'instructions:u') for r in rows]
    return {'processes': len(rows), 'median_ms': statistics.median(medians), 'process_medians_ms': medians, 'median_instructions': statistics.median(instructions), 'process_instructions': instructions}


summary = {}
for phase in ['planning', 'execution']:
    summary[phase] = {}
    for case in (controls + targets if phase == 'execution' else ['float_compare_f32_ansitrue', 'in_integer_ansitrue', 'no_division_ansitrue']):
        groups = {v: stats([r for r in runs if r['variant'] == v and r['case'] == case and r['phase'] == phase]) for v in ['before', 'after']}

        if case in references:
            reference = stats([r for r in runs if r['variant'] == 'reference' and r['case'] == case and r['phase'] == phase])
            summary[phase][case].update(reference=reference, after_vs_reference_latency_change_pct=100 * (groups['after']['median_ms'] / reference['median_ms'] - 1), after_vs_reference_instruction_change_pct=100 * (groups['after']['median_instructions'] / reference['median_instructions'] - 1))
    print(phase, summary[phase], flush=True)
(p / 'performance-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + '\n')

env = os.environ.copy()
assert not any(k.startswith(('MALLOC_', 'GLIBC_', 'LD_PRELOAD', 'DECIMAL_BENCH_')) for k in env)
directions = [False, True] * (pair_count // 2)
assert len(directions) == pair_count
random.Random(88).shuffle(directions)
pairs = [(reverse, address_mode) for reverse in directions]
if address_mode == 'mixed':
    assert pair_count % 4 == 0

    random.Random(88).shuffle(pairs)
binary_sha256 = {v: hashlib.sha256((p / f'{v}-bench').read_bytes()).hexdigest() for v in ['before', 'after']}
runs = []
for pair, (reverse, run_address_mode) in enumerate(pairs):

                   '{instructions:u,cycles:u,branches:u,branch-misses:u},task-clock:u,context-switches:u,cpu-migrations:u,page-faults:u',
                   '--', *launch, str(q / f'{variant}-bench'),
                   str(directory / 'capture.json'), mode, case]
        result = subprocess.run(command, env=env | {'DECIMAL_BENCH_PERF_DIR': str(directory),
                                'DECIMAL_BENCH_PERF_PHASE': 'execution', 'DECIMAL_BENCH_RETAIN': 'none'},
                                capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=180)
        capture = load(directory / 'capture.json')

        for row in capture['results']:
            assert all(row[k] == v for k, v in canonical[variant][row['id']].items())
            if mode == 'subqueries':
                assert row['retention'] == 'none' and row['retained_rows'] == 0
        timed = capture['results'][0] if mode == 'subqueries' else next(r for r in capture['results'] if r['ansi'])
        assert len(timed['samples_ms']) == len(timed['planning_samples_ms']) == 9
        counters = [json.loads(line) for line in (directory / 'counters.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('{')]
        assert len(counters) == 8 and all(c['pcnt-running'] == 100 for c in counters)
        assert result.stderr.count('Events enabled') == 1
        runs.append({'label': label, 'variant': variant, 'pair': pair, 'address_mode': run_address_mode, 'command': command,
                     'samples_ms': timed['samples_ms'], 'planning_samples_ms': timed['planning_samples_ms'],
                     'median_ms': statistics.median(timed['samples_ms']), 'counters': counters})
    (out / 'runs.json').write_text(json.dumps({'binary_sha256': binary_sha256, 'case': case, 'scenario': scenario, 'address_mode': address_mode,
                                            'pair_count': pair_count, 'pair_schedule': pairs, 'runs': runs}, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(scenario, address_mode, pair + 1, '/', pair_count, flush=True)

groups = {}
for label in ['before', 'after']:
    selected = [r for r in runs if r['label'] == label]
    assert len(selected) == pair_count
    groups[label] = {
        'process_medians_ms': [r['median_ms'] for r in selected],
        'median_ms': statistics.median(r['median_ms'] for r in selected),
        'median_counters': {event: statistics.median(float(next(c['counter-value'] for c in r['counters'] if c['event'] == event)) for r in selected)
                            for event in [c['event'] for c in selected[0]['counters']]},
    }
ratios = []
for pair in range(pair_count):
    rows = {r['label']: r for r in runs if r['pair'] == pair}
    ratios.append(100 * (rows['after']['median_ms'] / rows['before']['median_ms'] - 1))
rng = random.Random(88)
resampled = sorted(statistics.median(rng.choices(ratios, k=pair_count)) for _ in range(10000))
summary = {
    'groups': groups,
    'latency_change_pct': 100 * (groups['after']['median_ms'] / groups['before']['median_ms'] - 1),
    'paired_changes_pct': ratios,
    'median_paired_change_pct': statistics.median(ratios),
    'paired_median_bootstrap_95_percentile_interval': [resampled[249], resampled[9749]],
    'interval_note': 'Resample whole fresh-process pairs, not the nine within-process samples. This interval is conditional on this machine and run series.',
    'counter_changes_pct': {event: 100 * (groups['after']['median_counters'][event] / value - 1)
                            for event, value in groups['before']['median_counters'].items() if value != 0},
}
(out / 'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2), flush=True)

import hashlib
import json
import mmap
import re
import struct
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

p = Path(__file__).parent
q = p
profiles = json.loads((p / 'profiles.json').read_text())
top = re.search(r'^\s+[\d.]+%\s+\[.\]\s+(.+?)\s+-\s+-\s*$', profiles[0]['report'], re.M).group(1)
selected = [top]
records = [{'name': name} for name in selected]
sha = lambda data: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
for variant in ['before', 'after']:
    binary = q / f'{variant}-bench'
    symbols = subprocess.check_output(['nm', '-SC', '--defined-only', str(binary)], text=True)
    (p / f'{variant}-symbols.txt').write_text(symbols)
    rows = [row for line in symbols.splitlines() if len(row := line.split(maxsplit=3)) == 4]
    names = {int(row[0], 16): row[3] for row in rows if int(row[0], 16) != 0}
    with binary.open('rb') as file, mmap.mmap(file.fileno(), 0, access=mmap.ACCESS_READ) as elf:
        assert elf[:6] == b'\x7fELF\x02\x01'
        section_offset = struct.unpack_from('<Q', elf, 0x28)[0]
        section_size, section_count = struct.unpack_from('<HH', elf, 0x3a)
        relocations = {}
        for i in range(section_count):
            section = struct.unpack_from('<IIQQQQIIQQ', elf, section_offset + i * section_size)
            if section[1] != 4:  # SHT_RELA
                continue
            for at in range(section[4], section[4] + section[5], section[9]):
                address, info, addend = struct.unpack_from('<QQq', elf, at)
                if info & 0xffffffff == 8:  # R_X86_64_RELATIVE
                    relocations[address] = addend
        for n, record in enumerate(records):
            found = [row for row in rows if row[3] == record['name']]
            assert len(found) == 1
            start, size = [int(x, 16) for x in found[0][:2]]
            assembly = subprocess.check_output(['objdump', '-d', '-C', '--no-show-raw-insn', '-Mintel',
                                               f'--start-address={start}', f'--stop-address={start + size}', str(binary)], text=True)
            normalized, resolved = [], {}
            for line in assembly.splitlines():
                instruction = re.match(r'^\s*([0-9a-f]+):\s+(.*)$', line)
                if not instruction:
                    continue
                op = instruction[2]
                slot = re.search(r'#\s+([0-9a-f]+) <_DYNAMIC[^>]*>', op)
                if slot:
                    target = relocations[int(slot[1], 16)]
                    name = names[target]
                    resolved[slot[1]] = {'target': hex(target), 'name': name}
                    op = op[:slot.start()] + '# <' + name + '>'
                op = re.sub(r'\[rip[+-]0x[0-9a-f]+\]', '[rip+relocation]', op)
                op = re.sub(r'\b[0-9a-f]+ <', '<', op)
                normalized.append(f'{int(instruction[1], 16) - start:04x} {op}')
            normalized = '\n'.join(normalized) + '\n'
            record[variant] = {'start': hex(start), 'size': size, 'alignment_mod64': start % 64,
                               'normalized_sha256': sha(normalized.encode()),
                               'instruction_count': len(normalized.splitlines()), 'resolved_slots': resolved,
                               'normalized': normalized, 'assembly': assembly}
            (p / f'code-{n}-{variant}.txt').write_text(assembly)
            (p / f'normalized-{n}-{variant}.txt').write_text(normalized)
for record in records:
    record['normalized_equal'] = record['before']['normalized'] == record['after']['normalized']
(p / 'code-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps({
    'method': 'Compare instruction offsets and operations, remove link addresses from named calls and RIP references, and resolve anonymous GOT slots using ELF R_X86_64_RELATIVE relocations and symbol names. This checks selected function bodies, not the entire executable or runtime data placement.',
    'functions': records,
}, indent=2) + '\n')
for record in records:
    print(record['before']['instruction_count'], 'instructions; equal:', record['normalized_equal'], record['name'][:140])
